method: 3 warm-ups then 30 sequential samples per operation; p50 median; p95 nearest rank
scope: Includes validation, artifact stat guard, semantic probes, compilation, read-only lease, exact arithmetic, sorting and result validation
limits: 128MB DuckDB engine memory, 1 thread, 5-second lease, no spill, 100 output rows, 20000 groups
limitations: Local warm OS cache; single process; not Render, HTTP or Gemini latency
privacy: Only aggregate timings are recorded. No queries, parameters, plans, entities or answers are persisted.
